text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opposition throughout with reasons in each paragraph","quality":"stated position and consistency","description":"The essay keeps a clear argument against driverless cars and stays on that side from beginning to end."},{"evidence":"\"In fact, in many states they do not allow driverless cars\" and \"If someone is injuried... who takes the blaim\"","quality":"use of source-based evidence","description":"The essay supports its claims with specific details from the article rather than only giving general opinions."},{"evidence":"\"It has to notify the driver when human skills are required\" and \"The driverless car needs the drivers assistance\"","quality":"explanation of evidence","description":"The essay does more than quote facts; it explains how those facts support the anti-driverless-car position."},{"evidence":"introductory history sentence, two body paragraphs, concluding restatement","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay has a clearer essay structure with an introduction, body development, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"If someone is injuried by a technological error in the car, who takes the blaim for it?\"","quality":"argumentative reasoning","description":"The essay raises a concrete issue about liability and uses it to strengthen the case against the technology."}]}
